queue_dependency.input: GM->UB EnQue sets MTE2_V; DeQue waits. FreeTensor sets V_MTE2; AllocTensor on reused slot waits until all input V reads complete.
queue_dependency.output: V writes/copy -> EnQue V_MTE3 -> DeQue wait -> DataCopyPad. FreeTensor sets MTE3_V; subsequent AllocTensor waits before vector writes/trig scratch.
queue_dependency.p0: Copy both valid padded half arrays from input to output via VEC, then normal VECOUT EnQue/DeQue and stores; input is never used directly as MTE3 source.
queue_dependency.scratch: FP32 c/s/tmp persist in3cap work; angle is output[0:pitch], temp output[cap:cap+pitch], q tmp[0:pitch], only before rotation output writes. FP16 a/b/trig scratch before inputs loaded, then a/b retained while lo/hi/tmp used.
queue_dependency.prefetch: Prefetch(begin) only when begin<end; after DeQue current, prefetch job+1 only if job+1<end. Max2 live input slots, no unconsumed last prefetch. Output slots max2; final PIPE_ALL drains.

frequency_scratch_caveat: FP32 work shrinks5cap to3cap. FillDeviceFrequencies function/math unchanged, but scratch-derived vector chunk/fallback can differ for small heads. Large target cap4096 still uses full pitch in either layout. Explicitly verify outputs across all1625; do not claim initialization cost unchanged in smaller families.

small_head_review.trig: For cap>=pitch, output2cap holds angle[pitch] and temp at offsetcap; tmp3rd work vector holds q[pitch]. All disjoint from persistent c/s. No minimum64-lane scratch assumption.
